feeds.title: Costco Wine Blog » French
feeds.description: Stay updated on the latest, most exceptional French wines with Costco Wine. This is a resource to learn more about the wines you will find at Costco - so you can find extreme values, enjoy the remarkable selection, and perhaps be compelled to try new wines that you may have overlooked before.

feeds.title: Boulogne Wine Blog
feeds.description: This site includes a mixture of wine reviews (both by me and by members), reviews of other wine-related things (books, classes, ) and also other things to do in and around Boulogne-Sur-Mer. Read reviews on wines and learn what else there is to do in and near Boulogne.

feeds.title: Zinfandel Chronicles » Bordeaux
feeds.description: Zinfandel Chronicles shares articles on Bordeaux here. I started buying, collecting, and consuming wine in the early 1990s. My favorite wines include California Zinfandel, Napa Cabernet, Russian River Valley Pinot Noir, Bordeaux, Chateauneuf-du-Pape, and, last but not least, Washington wines.

feeds.title: Sip Wine Blog
feeds.description: Sip Wine Blog is by Nicolle Croft, Wine Guide. Nicolle is a wine writer/guide with 30 yrs in Bordeaux. Browse through her articles to read reviews and get insights into various categories of wines.

feeds.title: French Wine Tutor
feeds.description: My French language journey began when I was 11 and continued all the way to college, where I majored in it. I've since lived there three times. The language and the culture came first and the passion for wine soon followed. I started this blog because I kept hearing that American friends were terrified to drink French wine.

feeds.title: France Wine Tours Blog
feeds.description: Keep up with what's new with the France wine tour blog. Get travel tips and information to help plan your next wine tour in France. We are a Franco-American couple who help others quench their thirst for transformative travel. Our mission is to provide France wine tours to help wine lovers become connoisseurs. We sweat the small stuff when designing a tour. These include pairing accommodations with clients' preferences, a guide that has a similar background or a quality to enhance the wine touring experience, and more.

feeds.title: Natalie MacLean Blog » French Wine
feeds.description: The following section is dedicated to articles and reviews on French Wine. You love wine and you want to know which bottles to buy and what dishes to pair with them. I didn't name myself the Chief of Wine Happiness for nothing! Don't panic. I'll help you figure out the confusing choices with wines. I'm advanced in my wine knowledge. Choose a bottle each week that I've reviewed and taste to see what you get from the aromas and flavors.

feeds.title: Vinopointer.com » French Wine
feeds.description: Read about the most delicious French Wines by Vinopointer. In some 25 years of being in the wine business, and the business of wine, I have literally tasted thousands of wines. Good wines, horrid wines, and everything in between. And here, our goals are to help wine consumers sniff out good wines, and alert you to their presence. In short, to point them out, and to help you avoid the dogs.

feeds.title: Cellar Tours Blog » France
feeds.description: Cellar Tours features food, wine & travel reports from France in this particular section of the blog. Recommended by Wine Enthusiast, Forbes Traveller, the Wall Street Journal, and Time Magazine, Cellar Tours is the premier provider of private, chauffeured luxury food and wine tours. Our luxury tours are 100% customized and tailored to your tastes and needs. Operating since 2003 and offering exclusive Mercedes chauffeured vacations.
